findings.title: Write path never rechecks cache and can wipe a good value
findings.body: GetWebAssets drops the read lock, then later takes the write lock and always reloads and assigns entryPointAssetsCache = result (line 69), including when the load fails and result is nil. There is no second check of entryPointAssetsCache under the write lock. Two callers can both observe a nil cache; the first populates it successfully and the second then overwrites that pointer with nil (or a redundant load) if its file read fails. Later non-dev requests miss the cache and fail until a later load succeeds. After Lock(), return the existing cache when Env is not Dev and it is already non-nil, and do not store a nil/error result over a successful one.
